<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 224.120 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈ 223.113 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈ 17 % M+1 intensity) suggests about 15 carbon atoms (≈ 1.1 % per carbon). A formula that matches the mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₅H₁₁O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 223.0758 Da, within typical experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula is C15H11O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H11O2</final_answer>
